summary.text: Three crystal mountains at the north of Mini Northern Plains, the snowman tribe's home inside Fang Yuan's sovereign immortal aperture.

claims.text: At the north-most end of Mini Northern Plains, snow falls and frost energy permeates. A huge blizzard stops and three huge crystal mountains appear from within the fog. The snowmen name that home Triple Sacred Mountain and pray toward it, believing their tribe’s immortals live there. Fang Yuan’s time path clone has already set food, environment, and plants, and runs the snow crystal formation so snow monsters form as well.

Xue Er is tasked by Fang Yuan to manage Triple Sacred Mountain. She controls the snow crystal formation and focuses on the snowman tribe’s expansion. Frost ice flames spread on triple sacred mountain and burn snowmen and snow monsters. The ice path crystal essence is the core of the snow crystal formation; Fang Yuan used the formation to spread frost energy from that essence and build a habitat that suits the snowmen. Fang Yuan arrives, draws the frost ice flames away, and leaves the rest to Xue Er.

When Fang Yuan issues the contribution board, mission board, and exchange list inside the sovereign immortal aperture, Gu Immortals cheer at Mini Northern Plains’ Triple Sacred Mountain along with other major areas.

Triple Sacred Mountain is the center of Mini Northern Plains, the gathering area of snowmen, and the most developed area there. Xue Er looks after it. Sacred Eagle City Lord asks Triple Sacred Mountain for reinforcements when tribulation clouds gather.
